name: EDW Migrate D7
description: A developer helper module for Drupal 7 to Drupal 8+ migrations: ships reusable Migrate source, process and destination plugins plus a hook that strips the auto-generated migrate_drupal migrations.
library_dependencies: league/csv (required at runtime only by the 'csv' source plugin via League\Csv\Reader; not declared in a composer.json, so it must already be present, e.g. from migrate_source_csv or another dependency)
project_description: EDW Migrate D7 is a developer aid for building Drupal 7 to Drupal 8/9/10/11 migrations. It does not run any migration on its own and ships no UI, routes, permissions, services or configuration. Instead it provides a library of reusable Migrate API plugins that you reference from your own migration YAML: source plugins for D7 nodes, taxonomy terms (including i18n and Entity Translation variants), users, files, menu links, draggableviews structure, locale strings and CSV files; process plugins for downloading remote files to a fid, generating paragraphs, extracting the deepest array value and stripping inline CSS styles; and destination plugins that write directly to content_access, draggableviews_structure and the locales_source / locales_target tables. It also implements hook_migration_plugins_alter() to remove the migrations auto-generated by migrate_drupal (and any file-discovered migration), so you drive the upgrade entirely with explicit migration configs. Depends on core Migrate plus Migrate Plus, Migrate Tools and Migrate Drupal.
